top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not Registered (26 TAC §HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not R)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were 5 unrelated children found in care at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The smoke detector was not working and there was not a smoke detector in the front room.

top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training-Primary Caregiver and Employee Transporting (26 TAC §747.1314)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not have the required transportation training.

top_violation_types.title: Maintain Immunizations and Health records On Related Children (26 TAC §747.627)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: All four of the students files were missing immunizations.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no annual training hours available for viewing.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.
